thread:
maria_support: Hey team — ACME (tenant: brightship) is seeing intermittent p95 token latency spikes and 429s from their dedicated pool (pool-id: eu2-compact-04). Started ~09:00 UTC. They reported autoscaler bumped a fractional slice and then spikes occurred. Logs attached below. 

maria_support: sample API error: `{"code":"RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED","message":"rate limit / capacity hit","retry_after":5}` :thinking_face:

maria_support: quick `nvidia-smi` snapshot from node nid-eu2-84 around spike:
```
GPU 0: SM 96% MEM 78% PID tenant-brightship(0)
GPU 1: SM 94% MEM 82% PID tenant-other(1)
GPU 2: SM 12% MEM 10% PID system
GPU 3: SM 98% MEM 85% PID tenant-intense(2)
```

jordan_eng: thanks, Maria. do we have the MIG partitioning for that node? specifically which slices are 1g/2g/7g etc and which tenant on which slice? :eyes:

maria_support: good Q — attaching what infra gave: `eu2-compact-04 -> [slice-0:7G:brightship, slice-1:7G:tenant-intense, slice-2:2G:other, slice-3:1G:system]` (approx). we suspect the two 7G slices are contending on SM/L3.

ben_infra: pulling the MIG allocation now, here's the controller output: 
```
$ rsc mig list --node nid-eu2-84
NODE nid-eu2-84:
 - slice-A (7g) owner=brightship slot=0
 - slice-B (7g) owner=tenant-intense slot=1
 - slice-C (2g) owner=other slot=2
 - slice-D (1g) owner=sys slot=3
```

ben_infra: observed cross-slice SM thrash on that node during the window — SM util >95 on both 7g slices, memory working set backed by shared L3 causing stalls.

tanya_sre: are we seeing KV cache lock contention when brightship does long-context generation? Maria, do we have their sample request (tokens/context len)?

maria_support: yes — they sent a repro payload: 2048 tokens prompt + streaming generate ~1200 tokens; p95 jumps from 90ms to 1.2s intermittently. Attached request id 2026-08-11-ACME-901.

acme_ops_bot: FYI from tenant side: they saw `429` with `retry_after: 10` and then multiple `503` on followups. They temporarily reduced concurrency and saw improvement.

jordan_eng: sounds like noisy neighbor on SM+L3. two quick mitigations: 1) avoid colocating two heavy 7G slices on same physical GPU where possible (anti-affinity), 2) throttle burst concurrency or enforce token caps per connection. Can infra migrate brightship to a different spare node?

ben_infra: we have one spare node in eu2 (nid-eu2-91) with identical hw but currently low utilization. can do live migration for their slice to test. planning window?

lena_ce: customer prefers immediate mitigation — agreed to migration window in next 10 minutes. they want us to validate p95 and 429 counts post-migration.

tanya_sre: before migration, can we capture perf counters to confirm L3 eviction rates? run this on node during spike window: 
```
nvprof --events l3_cache_hit,l3_cache_miss --duration 60s
```

ben_infra: queued perf capture. also enabling temporary packer policy that forbids packing 7G+7G pairs on same host (will be enforced for new placements). existing placements need manual migration.

maria_support: ACTION: schedule migration of brightship slice to nid-eu2-91, set tenancy to isolated for 24h, throttle their max concurrency to 6 until we confirm stability. I'll notify ACME. :thumbsup:

acme_ops_bot: confirmed. after lowering concurrency to 6, immediate p95 dropped to ~180ms and no 429s for 7 minutes. ready for migration test.

ben_infra: migration started at 2125562400. will post logs when complete.

ben_infra: migration complete 2125563600. node nid-eu2-84 now has slice-B (tenant-intense) + slice-C, nid-eu2-91 hosts brightship slice-A.

maria_support: post-migration telemetry from brightship: p95 stable ~140-200ms over 10m, 0 new 429s. customer reporting no immediate regressions. :relieved:

jordan_eng: great. next steps: longer-term, need placement policy change in scheduler to prefer heterogenous slice types and avoid high-two-7g collocations. also add autoscaler guard to not allow fractional immediate bump that results in colocating two heavy slices. filing infra ticket.

tanya_sre: also add a regression alert rule on combined SM_util>85% across two slices on same node for >30s. that'll auto-create pager if noisy neighbor emerges.

maria_support: i'll summarize for ACME and close the thread once infra ticket is created. cc @jordan_eng @ben_infra

ben_infra: filed INFRA-4432 "avoid 7G+7G packing on compact nodes" and scheduled scheduler change for next deploy.

lena_ce: customer follow-up scheduled in 24h. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
